instruction_covers: Explicit 'order by i asc' read and written as duckdb must keep ASC (SELECT i FROM RANGE(5) AS _(i) ORDER BY i ASC)
Bare ORDER BY must stay bare for duckdb because default_order can be DESC
DESC rendering and default-dialect unspecified ORDER BY are preserved; ASC NULLS LAST for duckdb renders 'ORDER BY x ASC' with NULLS LAST omitted
label: sound
notes: Repo verified: Parser._parse_ordered discards ASC (parser.py:2947 self._match(TokenType.ASC) ignored) so bare and ASC both yield desc=False; Generator.ordered_sql renders sort_order ' DESC' or '' only (generator.py:1668) with no ASC path; DuckDB.NULL_ORDERING is nulls_are_last (duckdb.py:108), so ordered_sql already suppresses NULLS LAST on ASC at base. The NULLS LAST omission therefore pre-exists and any ASC-preserving fix keeps it without extra work (R3, which fires before R4); the linked orderby page is background rather than a new serialization the fix must invent. Base output for the NULLS LAST case already drops NULLS LAST and differs only by the stated missing ASC.
